cc:Work.dc:title: game4-first-half
cc:Work.dc:description: Game 4 first half: Golden State shot 17/40 (42.5%) and Atlanta 8/19 (42.1%). Golden State had four turnovers to Atlanta's 14 and led 42–26 at halftime. First-half free-throw attempts were Golden State six and Atlanta 14.
